info.name: Mist Admins Sites Devices - Others API

params.name: vendor
params.description: Filter results by vendor

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address

params.name: serial
params.description: Filter results by device serial number

params.name: model
params.description: Filter results by device model

params.name: name
params.description: Filter results by name

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: page
params.description: Select the page number to return when using page-based pagination; starts at `1`

items.docs: List third-party devices in a site, such as devices discovered or tracked outside the managed Mist device inventory. Use [List Org Other Devices](/#operations/listOrgOtherDevices) to retrieve third-party devices across the organization.

params.name: distinct
params.description: Field used to group this count response. enum: `mac`, `site_id`, `type`, `vendor`

params.name: type
params.description: See [List Device Events Definitions](/#operations/listOtherDeviceEventsDefinitions)

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

items.docs: Count third-party device events for a site, optionally grouped by the `distinct` field and filtered by event type and time range. Use [Count Org Other Device Events](/#operations/countOrgOtherDeviceEvents) to count third-party device events across the organization.

params.name: mac
params.description: Filter results by MAC address

params.name: device_mac
params.description: MAC of attached device

params.name: vendor
params.description: Filter results by vendor

params.name: type
params.description: See [List Device Events Definitions](/#operations/listOtherDeviceEventsDefinitions)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page

params.name: start
params.description: Lower bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d` or `-1w`

params.name: end
params.description: Upper bound of the time range, as an epoch timestamp in seconds or a relative value such as `-1d`, `-2h`, or `now`

params.name: duration
params.description: Time range duration for the query, using relative units such as `10m`, `7d`, or `2w`

params.name: sort
params.description: On which field the list should be sorted, -prefix represents DESC order

params.name: search_after
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving subsequent pages of results. This value is automatically populated by Mist in the `next` URL from the previous response and should not be manually constructed.

items.docs: Search third-party device events for a site with filters for device identifiers, model, vendor, event type, and time range. Use [Search Org Other Device Events](/#operations/searchOrgOtherDeviceEvents) to search third-party device events across the organization.
